changelog: - **Partner portal: payouts get their own name in Turkish** (#3350). "Ödemeler" meant both a customer's payments (admin) and the payouts to a partner (portal). The portal's payout menu entry, page title, empty state, detail title, back link and bank-details hint now say "Hak ediş ödemeleri". EN (Payouts / Payments) and DE (Auszahlungen / Zahlungen) already separated the two.

en: Turkish partner account: payouts made to you are now named "Hak ediş ödemeleri" and no longer share a name with customer payments.
tr: Partner hesabında sana yapılan ödemeler artık "Hak ediş ödemeleri" adıyla geçiyor; müşteri ödemeleriyle karışmıyor.
de: Türkisches Partnerkonto: Auszahlungen an Sie heißen jetzt "Hak ediş ödemeleri" und teilen sich keinen Namen mehr mit Kundenzahlungen.
